findings.quote: to automatically comply with open source licenses
findings.diagnosis: This describes automatic license compliance more broadly than the documented process supports.
findings.evidence: Line 39 requires contributors to determine whether the system satisfies each dependency's license requirements, consult a lawyer if unsure, and verify acceptability before accepting the license. These conditions limit the compliance claim.
findings.deletion_test: Deleting this purpose clause preserves the statement that the project uses cargo-about, its link, and all troubleshooting instructions while removing the unsupported automatic-compliance claim.
